title: receipt
description: A retail or restaurant receipt. Amounts are plain numbers in the receipt's currency, without thousands separators or currency symbols. Use null for anything that is not printed.

line_items.description: Purchased items in the order they are printed. One entry per printed line item; sub-items (toppings, modifiers) belong to their parent item and are not separate entries.

name.description: Item name as printed, without the quantity, unit price or line total.

quantity.description: Number of units on the line. 1 when no quantity is printed.

unit_price.description: Price of one unit, only when it is printed separately from the line total.

line_total.description: Total printed for the line (quantity × unit price).

subtotal.description: Sum of the line items before discounts, service charge and tax, when printed.

discount.description: Total discount applied to the receipt, with the sign as printed (usually negative).

service_charge.description: Service charge or gratuity line, when printed.

tax.description: Tax amount (VAT, PB1, PPN, ...), when printed as an amount.

cash_paid.description: Cash tendered by the customer, when printed.

change.description: Change returned to the customer, when printed.

card_paid.description: Amount paid by credit or debit card, when printed.

item_count.description: Total number of items printed as a count (e.g. 'Total Qty 3'), when printed.
